primary_meaning: the good news of salvation through the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ

alternatives.meaning: the four canonical New Testament books (Matthew, Mark, Luke, John) that narrate the life and ministry of Jesus
basis: early church usage and titles of the books

alternatives.meaning: the announcement of the kingdom of God / reign of God as present and future reality
a literary genre of ancient biography focused on Jesus

notes: Across historic Christian teaching the Greek euangelion is uniformly rendered and understood as 'good news.' The precise content of that news (kingdom emphasis vs. cross-resurrection emphasis) receives different accents, yet these are complementary rather than contradictory readings of the same core term. No significant symbolic or allegorical redefinition exists outside this consensus.
